question: How is all-pervading brahman established in sacrifice and action?
premises: brahman is born from the imperishable
all-pervading brahman is eternally established in sacrifice
the wheel of sacrifice drives beings toward liberation
inference: brahman pervades and is established in sacrifice, whose wheel of action and knowledge sustains beings and leads to liberation
uncertainties: very long fused compounds and multiple interpretive layers
plain_english: Know action as born from brahman and brahman from the imperishable; all-pervading brahman is eternally established in sacrifice.
